name: Methylphenidate
class: CNS stimulant, dopamine/norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (Schedule II)
description: A dopamine and norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor approved for attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder and narcolepsy. A Schedule II controlled substance with a boxed warning for abuse and dependence.

systems.note: Catecholamine reuptake inhibition is the labelled mechanism and indication.
Blood pressure and heart rate elevation and sudden cardiac events are labelled.
Appetite suppression and weight loss are labelled.

monitors.why: Labelled appetite suppression and weight loss.
Stimulants alter mood and affect; withdrawal and rebound are labelled.
